notes: Custom Next.js/Sitecore site; www.mckinsey.com itself tarpits plain HTTP clients (curl hangs, Akamai), but the search API it calls is on another host and answers curl with a browser UA, no cookies/keys: GET https://gateway.mckinsey.com/apigw-x0cceuow60/v1/api/jobs/search?pageSize=20&start=1&lang=en&q=strategy (base = publicRuntimeConfig API_HOST_GLOBAL_SEARCH_EXTERNALIZED_SERVICE + '/apigw-' + GLOBAL_SEARCH_API_GATEWAY_ID + '/v1' in the page's __NEXT_DATA__; the gateway id could change). Response JSON: {numFound, start, docs:[{jobID, title, friendlyURL, cities[], countries[], continents[], interest, interestCategory, functions[], whoYouWillWorkWith, whatYouWillDo, yourBackground (HTML; these three are the full description, ~6.5k chars together), jobApplyURL (mckinsey.avature.net), ...}]}. 623 jobs with no query, 328 for q=strategy. Paging is 1-based 'start' = page number (start=6 returned different docs; response 'start' field always 0). Filter params in the site JS: interest, cities, countries, interestCategory, industries, functions (a 'countries=United States' param reduced numFound to 90 but the first docs were multi-country, so filter on docs[].countries client-side). Single job: GET .../v1/api/jobs/details?friendlyUrl=<friendlyURL> -> same doc shape. Public job URL: https://www.mckinsey.com/careers/search-jobs/jobs/<friendlyURL>. jobs.mckinsey.com is the Avature apply portal only (no SearchJobs, feed empty).

Avature portal on careers.bain.com (www.bain.com/careers is behind a Cloudflare challenge - 403 to curl - but careers.bain.com is not). Search (HTML, GET, browser UA): https://careers.bain.com/jobs/SearchJobs/<keyword>?folderRecordsPerPage=50&folderOffset=<n> (keyword path segment optional; 50 per page accepted) -> result links href="https://careers.bain.com/jobs/FolderDetail/<Title-Slug>/<id>". RSS: https://careers.bain.com/jobs/SearchJobs/feed/?folderRecordsPerPage=50 -> <item><title>, <link> (FolderDetail URL), <pubDate>, <description> is only ' - <req id>'; feed returned 20 items regardless of page size. Detail page (HTML 200): has a JSON-LD JobPosting with title but EMPTY description; the text is in the HTML under div.article__content / .article__content__view__field__value (fields: Job Title, Job ID, Work Areas, Employment Type, Location(s), then description). Global board; filter by Location(s) for US. No adapter for Avature yet - one Avature adapter would cover Bain, Deloitte US and Slalom.

JSON search: GET https://kearney.recsolu.com/job_boards/EPd41qlA4_03IncZMnWyRQ/search?query=&page_number=1 with X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest -> {"html": "
  • ...?job_board_id=...>Title..."}. Detail https://kearney.recsolu.com/jobs/?job_board_id=EPd41qlA4_03IncZMnWyRQ is server-rendered HTML (h1 title, no JSON-LD). Yello has no adapter.

tal.net (Oleeo), no adapter. US/Americas job board: .../appcentre-2/brand-2/candidate/jobboard/vacancy/3/adv/ (other regions use other appcentre/vacancy numbers: appcentre-3 vacancy/5, appcentre-1 vacancy/1, appcentre-4 vacancy/7, middle_east vacancy/11). careers.kroll.com is a custom Next.js/Sitecore site (legacy TalentBrew assets only; the radancy adapter's /search-jobs/results path is 404 and paradox finds no links because results are rendered client-side from Sitecore Discover: POST https://discover.sitecorecloud.io/discover/v2/176843135, payload not captured). www.kroll.com is not a job board. What works without a browser: job pages https://careers.kroll.com/en/job/<city>/<slug>/<id> return 200 HTML with a JSON-LD JobPosting; the listing page HTML and its /_next/data/<buildId>/en/listing-page.json contain no job links. A small adapter would need the Discover search request (capture it from the page's network calls) plus the existing JSON-LD detail parsing.

(1) Search (HTML, GET): https://apply.deloitte.com/en_US/careers/SearchJobs/<keyword>?jobRecordsPerPage=10&jobOffset=<n> (keyword path segment optional; trailing-slash form 302s to this) -> result links href="https://apply.deloitte.com/en_US/careers/JobDetail/<Public-Title-Slug>/<id>"; pagination via jobOffset steps of 10. (2) RSS: https://apply.deloitte.com/en_US/careers/SearchJobs/feed/?jobRecordsPerPage=10 -> <item><title> (internal requisition name such as 'US E - Tax Manager - ...', not the public title), <link>/<guid> JobDetail URL, <pubDate>, empty <description>; the feed returned the same 20 items regardless of keyword/offset, so use the HTML search for paging. (3) Detail: the JobDetail URL returns HTML with two JSON-LD JobPosting blocks: one with the internal title and a ~9k-char description, one with the public title ('Head of Products, ConvergeSPORTS...') and a ~7.5k-char description; jobLocation address fields are empty, location is in the HTML (div.article__content). Other Deloitte candidates from the auto pass (lever 'deloitte', smartrecruiters 'Deloitte6') are not the US firm.

notes: verify_one ok (n=1). There is no Oliver Wyman-only Workday site (OliverWyman, Oliver_Wyman, OW all 404) and the MMC site has no company/business facet (facets: jobFamilyGroup, jobFamily, Location_Country, Location_Region_State_Province, timeType, workerSubType, locations). The workable restriction is the search text: searchText 'Oliver Wyman' + Location_Country = United States of America gives 93 postings, of which ~80 have 'Oliver Wyman' (or Lippincott) in the title and the rest are Oliver Wyman Actuarial / Veritas units. IMPORTANT: the config relies on "queries":["Oliver Wyman"] replacing the default role queries - if the scraper overrides queries with the MBA list, the result reverts to the whole Marsh McLennan board. For a hard guarantee, post-filter on title containing 'Oliver Wyman' or 'Lippincott'. n is low under the MBA title filter because OW titles are mostly 'Oliver Wyman - Consultant/Associate/Principal - <practice>', which title_ok does not match. The Phenom site careers.marsh.com/global/en/oliver-wyman-search is the same data; the phenom adapter cannot pass a business filter.
